outcome: Presence of bacteria in the placental membranes and basal plate decidua
finding: Presumptively intact placental microbes were visualized as low-abundance, low-biomass and sparse populations within the placenta regardless of gestational age and mode of delivery.
mod_finding: The taxonomic makeup of placental microbes was distinct between term and preterm cohorts.
